verdict.rationale: Homebrew exposes a well-documented CLI (Manpage) that can be scripted or invoked programmatically by an AI agent, but there is no dedicated public API, OpenAPI spec, or llms.txt — probes explicitly returned 404s for these. Missing for 10: a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI/GraphQL), an llms.txt or agent-friendly interface, and any first-party SDK for programmatic (non-CLI) access.
